1._extracted_caption: Table 1 Zero-Order Correlations, Intraclass Correlations (ICCs), and Means and Standard Deviations (SDs) of Study Variables.
1._section_summary: This section details intraclass correlations (ICCs) and zero-order correlations (both within-persons and between-persons) for various study variables, including BMI, exposure to body-focused and non-body-focused others, intuitive eating, dietary restraint, body appreciation, and body satisfaction. Table 1 presents these correlations, ICCs, and means/standard deviations. The text indicates that a higher mean level of exposure to body-focused others was associated with lower mean levels of intuitive eating and body appreciation.
